description: Follow a request for something only a person may do, such as entering a secret or signing in to a connector's provider, by the id a tool returned with its link: its state, when it expires, the link to give the person, who completed or declined it, what it set (names only, never values, and the connector a sign-in created), and what to do next. Pass wait_seconds to wait for the person before answering. While the answer carries retry_after_seconds, call again with wait_seconds 20. Never ask the person to type a secret into this conversation. Requires connecting a Valet account.

id.description: The request's id, from the tool that made it.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the request belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the request to change before answering; 0 answers at once. Use 20 while the answer carries retry_after_seconds.

name: get_request

completed_at.description: When the request was completed, as an RFC 3339 UTC time. Absent until it is completed.

completed_by.description: Display name of the person who completed the request. Absent until it is completed.

declined_at.description: When the request was declined, as an RFC 3339 UTC time. Absent unless it was declined.

declined_by.description: Display name of the person who declined the request. Absent unless it was declined.

expires_at.description: When the request expires unanswered, as an RFC 3339 UTC time.

fields.description: Names of what the person enters, never values.

kind.description: What the request asks for: env_vars, resource_vars, connector_keys, connector_sign_in, site_password, or policy_secrets.

name.description: Name of the website, app, or agent the request is for. Absent when the request names none or it no longer exists.

next_step.description: What to do next, given the state. Follow it.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

outcome.description: What the completed request set. Absent until it is completed.

connector.description: Name of the connector a sign-in created. Absent when none.

names.description: Names of the variables or secrets the person set, never values. Absent when none.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before calling get_request again. Present only while the request is pending.

state.description: pending while the person has not answered, completed, declined, or expired. A request leaves pending once answered or expired.

target.description: What completing the request acts on beyond name. Absent when the kind has no such target.

access.description: password when completing the request moves the service to password access. Present for a site_password request.

checker.description: Checker the policy runs. Present for a policy_secrets request.

connector.description: Name the connector has or will have. Present for a connector_keys or connector_sign_in request.

connector_entry.description: Catalog entry the connector is created from. Present for a connector_keys or connector_sign_in request.

policy.description: Release policy whose secrets the request saves. Present for a policy_secrets request.

provider.description: Display name of the provider the person signs in to. Present for a connector_sign_in request.

resource.description: Resource the secrets are set beside. Present for a resource_vars request.

url.description: Dashboard page to give the person. They open it signed in to Valet to complete the request. It holds no credential.

title: Get a secret request
